prototype_policy: synthetic programmatically generated data only; no AI; no token/latency cost
reframing: yt-dlp is a downloader, not a frame extractor; Path B = yt-dlp download + the SAME ffmpeg extraction. Not a symmetric two-extractor race.

environment.ffmpeg_host: 8.1.2 (Homebrew) — NOTE: no libfreetype (no drawtext), no libwebp

fixtures.generator: testsrc2 (burns timestamp/frame counter into every frame) + ffprobe ground truth + reference frames by exact frame number

extraction_results.pathB_note: extract step PSNR identical to Path A on every target — proving yt-dlp adds a download step then uses the SAME ffmpeg extraction. Download figures are LOCAL HTTP best-case lower bounds; real YouTube adds format selection, DASH/HLS, nsig, throttling.

container_via_ffmpeg_libwebp_q80.note: Debian ffmpeg has libwebp natively; no PIL needed in container

dependency_footprint.ffmpeg_host_macos: present (Homebrew), but Homebrew build lacks libwebp + drawtext

yt_dlp_toolchain.note: requires a Python runtime; pip blocked by PEP 668, needed pipx

windows_arm.type: ANALYSIS (not measured — cannot execute Windows ARM on this host)
windows_arm.ffmpeg_winarm64: AVAILABLE — BtbN publishes stable winarm64 builds (n7.1, n8.1; gpl/lgpl; shared/static)
windows_arm.yt_dlp_winarm64: AVAILABLE — yt-dlp_arm64.exe + yt-dlp_win_arm64.zip published, but bundles a Python interpreter (PyInstaller-style)

audio_only_input.pathA: clean error 'Output file does not contain any stream', exit 234, NO file produced

truncated_download.pathA: clean error 'moov atom not found', exit 183, NO file produced

failure_modes.non_keyframe_seek: lands 1 frame late (frame_error=1, ~30ms at 30fps) — ffmpeg -ss decodes accurately to next frame at/after target
failure_modes.ytdlp_download_sections: FAILED with ffmpeg exit 183 on faststart-less mp4 (moov at end) — yt-dlp's only time-window feature is brittle and re-encodes

verdicts.timestamp_accuracy: PROVEN ffmpeg — 0 frame error keyframe, +1 frame non-keyframe (within 1 frame)
verdicts.file_size_webp_encode_cost: PROVEN — WebP ~4.3-5.4x smaller than PNG, encode 6-25ms (PIL host) / 42ms (libwebp container first-call)
verdicts.wall_clock_speed: PROVEN ffmpeg — extract 44-80ms; Path B adds 363-394ms download (local best-case)
verdicts.dependency_footprint_per_platform: PROVEN ffmpeg — single binary, no runtime; yt-dlp adds ~102MB Python toolchain. macOS/Linux/Windows-ARM all have ffmpeg.
verdicts.temp_media_lifecycle_quota_fit: PROVEN ffmpeg — operates on already-downloaded temp file inside Task 6.4 lifecycle; Path B re-downloads outside it
verdicts.failure_modes: PROVEN ffmpeg — clean no-file failures on audio-only + truncated; feeds 7.5 placeholder/retry design
verdicts.container_operational_complexity: PROVEN ffmpeg — +543MB single apt layer; yt-dlp adds +116MB Python + pip. Container ffmpeg has libwebp natively.
